title: Open handoffs by deadline
description: Every OPEN handoff in every inbox, soonest deadline first; overdue rows show the warn tone.
why: Work stuck between two seats is the first thing to slip; the owner sees what is due and overdue without opening the inboxes.

actions.label: Ask the CEO about this
actions.text: This handoff is due {{row.raw}}: "{{row.heading}}" ({{row.file}}). Is it on track, and who is unblocking it?
